info.title: Live
info.description: The farm records a workshop. A session page's live item asks this farm to open a microphone with ffmpeg and write one-minute segments, with timestamps that never reset, into the page's assets folder; Begin, Finish and End are marks stamped on the recorder's own clock and kept in marks.json beside the segments. End stitches the segments into one m4a for the page. The recorder outlives the farm: a restart adopts it again.

get.description: state is idle, checking, recording, interrupted (ffmpeg died without an End; Record resumes), stopped or ended. clock is session seconds now; level the last peak readings in dBFS, five a second; marks every mark so far.

post.summary: Mic Check: open the microphone and feed the meter, recording nothing
post.description: Runs ffmpeg against the microphone for a while (30 s by default) so status carries its level. stop ends it early. While the recorder runs this does nothing: the meter is already live.

post.summary: Start the recorder (or resume it after an interruption)
post.description: Spawns ffmpeg, detached, writing assets/<slug>/live/seg-RR-NNNN.ts in one-minute segments. After an interruption a new run starts at the offset where the last one's audio stops, so session seconds stay the position in the stitched recording.

post.summary: End: the last mark, stop the recorder, stitch the recording
post.description: Writes the End mark, stops ffmpeg (it closes its last segment), and stitches every run into assets/<slug>/<slug>.m4a. The segments are kept until the page is reviewed. Called again it re-stitches.
